An '''engagement near Dorin'''<ref name="EpisodeGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}} </ref> was fought during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Point Rain" /> in [[21 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The battle saw Republic and Separatist forces clash near<ref name="Point Rain" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Aliens">''[[Star Wars: Aliens of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Dorin]], with Republic [[starfighter]] [[squadron]]s led by [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], engaging Separatist units<ref name="Point Rain" /> [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by the [[Kaleesh]] Separatist [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Commander]], [[General]] [[Grievous]]. Grievous's attack was to distract Republic forces from traveling to the planet [[Geonosis]], which the Republic [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia|had learned]] was the site of a new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry|droid factory]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Begin" />

The Republic starfighter squadrons were able to rout Grievous's forces,<ref name="Point Rain" /> which in turn led to the loss of at least 131 Separatist units.<ref name="Jedi Kills" /> Following their successes at Dorin, Skywalker and his Padawan arrived at Geonosis in order to participate in the Republic's [[Second Battle of Geonosis|second invasion]] of the world.<ref name="Point Rain" /> By [[19 BBY]],<ref name="ZeroCompanyDate">{{ZeroCompanyDate}}</ref> however, the war had returned to Dorin, which had fallen under [[Blockade of Dorin|Separatist blockade]].<ref name="Zero Company">''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The battle near Dorin was first indirectly mentioned in "[[Landing at Point Rain]],"<ref name="Point Rain" /> the fifth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired on [[November 4]], [[2009]].<ref name="Point Rain Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the [[Battle of Dorin]] was introduced in an article published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[November 3]], 2009.<ref name="Fan Days">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}}</ref> The battle later made its full first appearance and received its name in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="Adventures">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref> in [[2010]].<ref name="Season 3 Premiere Announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/season3_date/index.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Season 3 Premiere Date Announced}}</ref>
